grid_rationale: A nearly geometric ten-point grid over the previously fixed interval [9,65], with 34 snapped to the already evaluated M=33. The four previously evaluated sizes are retained and the six additions were fixed before running this extension.
representative_policy: Use existing baseline repetition index 0 (train seed 60000, validation seed 60002, test seed 60004) at M=17 for the interaction and trajectory panels. Never select the representative from errors or visual quality.
fixed_conditions: N=1000, T=2, dt=0.005, sigma=0.1, sigma_obs=0, QANR true kernel with eps=1e-8, Gaussian-mixture initial law, fixed weak tests, full ordered pairs, trapezoidal quadrature, 1/sqrt(200) row scaling, raw cyclic LASSO, and independent-validation selection are identical for every dictionary size and repetition.
selection_policy: For each dictionary and repetition, select among the same 60 logarithmic penalties by minimum independent-validation weak residual over converged candidates. Never consult the true kernel or test trajectory. Do not standardize, threshold, refit, or impose a support size.
stopping_rule: Run all 100 repetitions for all six added sizes irrespective of intermediate trends. Do not add, remove, or select sizes or seeds based on outcomes.
failure_policy: Retain every failed job, unconverged candidate, alpha-grid boundary selection, divergent rollout, and basis-domain excursion. If any planned metric is missing, its all-run mean and interval are null; never average only successful repetitions.
manuscript_instruction: Regenerate and inspect the three-panel practical-use figure. Do not edit the manuscript in this stage.
